decision_rule.text_anchor_score: count of required anchors present divided by 5
decision_rule.image_byte_ratio: event image manifest bytes divided by pre-event image manifest bytes
decision_rule.max_precip_mm: maximum across five event-day precipitation summaries
decision_rule.ledger_score: sum of four threshold tests: text score equals 1, image ratio at least 3, precipitation below 1 mm, and surface pre-scene total equals 0

criteria.name: Answer schema
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON fields with numeric values rounded to 6 decimals where applicable.

criteria.name: Text anchor score
criteria.description: Computes the 5-of-5 text anchor score correctly and ties it to the named anchors.

criteria.name: Image byte ratio
criteria.description: Computes the image byte ratio correctly from 98,702 and 22,655.

criteria.name: Precipitation threshold
criteria.description: Computes the precipitation maximum correctly and applies the less-than-1-mm threshold.

criteria.name: Surface pre-scene total
criteria.description: Computes the surface pre-scene total from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 counts.

criteria.name: Ledger score
criteria.description: Applies all four ledger tests correctly and gives a score of 4.

criteria.name: Concise label
criteria.description: Gives the label sudden summit phreatic plume signal or an equivalent wording.

criteria.name: No extra inference
criteria.description: Keeps the consistency note limited to the four computed tests without adding unmeasured impacts.
